title: Antoine de Bordeaux (London) to Brienne, 30 May 1653 NS, BL Add MS 4200 ff. 88-90 (Thurloe intercept)

steps.what: Symbol classes, token counts and IC (0.019) on the provisional transcription.
Design A from sibling keys of the same office: marked series are alphabetical syllabaries, overbar and three-digit groups are nomenclature.
Plaintext sought in Birch (Thurloe SP i) and Guizot's despatches; 30 May 1653 in neither. Found DECODE R7537, the English key for 'Mr. Bordeaux' 1653.
Solver recovers 99 % on design-A controls of equal length; 52 % and 9 % when 10 % of diacritics are misread.
Ciphertext-only annealing on the real text, 21+ seeds over series orders and unit lists.
Transcribed key sheet R7537; it confirms design A exactly.
Checked the page images: 21 corrections, two merged glyphs split, lost marks restored.
Applied the key plus context-derived additions; letter read except name codes and rare tokens.
Duplicate of the ending (R8391) agrees token for token; content fits the Ormée negotiations of May 1653.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: Item A (R8390, BL Add MS 4200 f. 88) was read with the English Deciphering Branch key sheet DECODE R7537 (BL Add MS 32263 f. 1, a separate key volume), found during the attempt after a ciphertext-only solver failed, then extended from context and checked against the page images and the duplicates R8391/R8393.
outcome.notes: Solver failure explained by transcription noise, as the noisy control predicted.

prior.where: English Deciphering Branch key sheet, BL Add MS 32263 f. 1 (DECODE R7537)

human: Supplied the DECODE login (session cookie) for the key sheet and page images.
